notes: family: point-salad-euro. Verified vs official rulebook p.10 and BGA help. Each card's scoring scroll (shields, grid position, purse gold, sets) is evaluated manually and entered per card; face-down cards score 0. Leftover keys = 1 pt each. Gold not stored on a purse scores nothing but breaks ties. Tie persists after gold: shared victory. 2-5 players; solo/other modes not modelled.

tiebreakers.description: Most leftover gold not stored in purses; if still tied, tied players win together.
